name: Moon
intro: The Moon pathway uses medicine, blood, beasts and lunar power. It combines healing and enhancement with dangerous biological and vampiric abilities.

meter.name: Blood Moon
meter.full: Replenish medicine or empower its delivery

ability.name: Healing Touch
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Healing Touch — Carry two medicine doses, each restoring 12% Max HP to the most injured ally. At 100 charge, replenish one dose and restore an extra 15% Max HP to the most injured ally.; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 15 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Beast Command
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Beast Command — A living beast gains 150% damage on its next landed attack, without an extra turn. At 100 charge, also heal it for 25% Max HP. Without a beast, make a paid basic attack at 250% strength. Prepared beasts enter free and stay for the battle.. 15 SP · Cooldown 1 turn.

ability.name: Blood Siphon
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Blood Siphon — Deals 150% INT Blood damage (25% base DEF bypass); Restores 30% of damage dealt by this cast; Sanguine powers begin at Sequence 7. At 100 charge, restore 15% Max HP to the most injured living ally.; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 30 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Moonlight Shield
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Moonlight Shield — Grants a 20% Max HP shield; lasts until depleted or dispelled; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 35 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Vampire Transformation
ability.label: Active Stance
ability.description: Vampire Transformation — Restores 28% of damage dealt by basic strikes and damaging skills for 3 turns; +20% SPEED for 3 turns; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 30 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Scarlet Blood Domain
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Scarlet Blood Domain — Targets all enemies; Deals 210% INT Blood damage (25% base DEF bypass); Immediately steals up to 15 SP plus 10% target Max SP per target, capped at your maximum SP; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 42 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Lunar Blessing
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Lunar Blessing — Immediately restores 30% Max HP HP, capped at Max HP; +25% INT for 2 turns; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 50 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Crimson Moon Curse
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Crimson Moon Curse — Deals 260% INT Blood damage (25% base DEF bypass); Enemy SPEED −20% for 2 turns; Lowers target accuracy by 20 percentage points for 2 turns; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 85 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Full Moon Cataclysm
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Full Moon Cataclysm — Targets all enemies; Deals 320% INT Blood damage (25% base DEF bypass); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 100 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Goddess of Crimson
ability.label: Active Authority
ability.description: Goddess of Crimson — Deals 320% INT True damage (ignores DEF and elemental resistance); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 120 SP · Cooldown 5 turns.
